name: poly-save-sidecar
description: When a melodic pattern is saved, also write the poly sidecar 'polyA' (A = current pattern letter) in the same project/track working directory from the CCM poly array 0x1000B530 + track*0x880. 2176 bytes = 128 steps x [count, note,vel x8]. Hook: 0x0801C542 (writer's f_close prep) -> cave 0x08047E00. Opens mode 0x0A (write/create-always) and uses f_open 0x0801496C / f_write 0x08014C92 / f_close 0x08014F18. Skips the drum track (r7 == 3). FIL at 0x1000E000, count at 0x1000E300. The cave performs the original f_close on the pattern FIL at sp+0x18 before returning.

patches.note: writer f_close prep -> save poly sidecar
